decides: The normalized and switch-rewritten exchange carries the tested start/restart node through the accepted typed purecap compiler to target agreement: the unchanged probe, split into 24 programs, agrees with the C oracle on all 576 rows natively and through compiler-diff program, its perturbed program fails on target, and the switch control program agrees on all 576 of its seeded rows natively and on target. It composes no Velus or purecap compiler theorem (F-467), re-accepts nothing bound to the accepted compiler and does not re-select the M8a route, which stays C.

orchestration.note: committed at source_revision and hashed by the freeze before provisioning; run refuses unless the script still has that hash, and check 5 rehashes it

changed_since_prior_freeze_scope: the inputs M6.1b-iii's exchange result froze that this freeze also holds; the normalizer, token comparison and control generator changes are M6.1b-iii's post-trial repair, whose equivalence run that result binds, and the asm.py and image.py changes are docstring-only

harness_sources_changed_since_prior_repo.note: compiler-diff's own source digests, as M6.1b-iii's probe report and this trial's probe report record them; every program report in this trial records one source set

tools.identity_scope: Each identity is the file's bytes at freeze and again at check 5. clang is bound with libclang-cpp, which holds the lexer the token comparison reads, and the native compiler with cc1, which compiles every native driver; their assemblers, linkers and the sanitizer runtime are bound only through the recorded versions. The profile is the lane copy of the recorded bytes, not the checkout's file (see profile).

profile.note: Formatting commit c3b0023d rewrote model/config/verifiedos.json after M6.1b-iii, so the checkout's file no longer has the recorded profile hash. Its bytes at M6.1b-iii's source revision d590c463 were written to the lane with git show before the freeze; they have the recorded hash, and vos.jsonc reads them and the checkout's file as the same JSON value. The simulator ran under the lane copy.

licence_reads.basis: Each read printed the whole file in the provisioning log, which the implementer read; the stage records hash each file and its lane copy and time the read. Sections 2, 3, 4 and 7 of each read as THIRD-PARTY.md records them.

authoring.note: an authoring-time read, before Velus ran on authoring drafts of the control program in the authoring lane; the accepted compiler and the simulator did not run before provisioning

shapes.if-else: one case with a non-empty body, a non-empty default
shapes.if-only: one case with a non-empty body, an empty default
shapes.else-only: one case labelled 0 with an empty body, a non-empty default
shapes.chain-else: two or more cases with non-empty bodies, a non-empty default
shapes.chain-only: two or more cases with non-empty bodies, an empty default

rewrite.lowering: if ((E) == K1) {B1} else if ((E) == K2) {B2} ... else {D}: every byte outside a switch and every body's bytes kept, only the label and break text replaced
rewrite.refused: every other switch: no case, an empty case body outside else-only, labels not strictly increasing or not decimal, a break that does not end a case, a case or default after the default, and a brace, label, conditional, if, loop, goto, continue or return in a body; case, default or break outside a switch

probe.state: the node's memory is empty, so a program boundary changes no answer

control.state: each program resets the node first and its answers are computed from that reset

checks.predicate: After the fresh freeze, the Velus, licence, compiler, configuration, simulator, profile and native-compiler hashes match M6.1b-iii's recorded identities, the opam switch export matches M6.1b-i's, and the Velus translation site and printer hash to the values the rewrite declares.
Velus re-emits the recorded printed Clight and header for the start/restart node.
The probe driver over the unnormalized Clight is still refused, natively and by the accepted compiler for its alignment.
Velus emits the switch control program's Clight.
The normalizer accepts the node's and the control program's printed Clight.
The switch rewrite accepts both normalized programs.
An independent clang-token comparison shows the rewritten node differing from its normalized form only at declared switch groups.
The same comparison shows the rewritten control program differing only at declared switch groups and carrying every declared shape, a nested group and labels out of plain order.
The comparison fails on a rewritten node with one comparison label moved and on one with a statement changed outside every group.
The rewrite refuses every authored undeclared-shape variant of the normalized node, writing nothing.
The rewrite returns switch-free input byte-identically: M6.1b-iii's normalized control program and both rewritten programs.
The rewritten node compiles through the accepted typed route.
The rewritten control program compiles through the accepted typed route.
The reference comparison passes.
The regenerated fixtures reproduce the recorded digest.
The unchanged probe over the rewritten node, split into programs that fit the text window, agrees on every row natively.
Every split probe program agrees on every row through compiler-diff program.
The perturbed probe program holding the moved check fails natively and yields a failing comparison verdict on target.
The split control drivers agree natively on every row of the seeded generated set.
Every split control program agrees on every row through compiler-diff program.
Every frozen input and tool identity rehashes unchanged.

observations: The node prints six switches, all if-else with label 0, three of them nested to depth three inside the delay group; the rewrite lowers all six, and the node's normalized form is byte-identical to M6.1b-iii's recorded one.

The switch control program prints eleven switches: four if-else, one if-only (label 3), one else-only, four chain-else (two over 0 to 2 with a default, one over 1 and 3) and one chain-only (labels 1 and 2), with one if-else nested in another.
Velus emits the switch control program with an empty log, without the semantic-existence warning it gives M6.1b-iii's control program (F-475).
Both rewritten programs compile through the accepted typed route with only the empty-struct warning the normalized node already drew.
The largest split program's text is 8956 bytes for the probe and 16040 for the control program, against the 32768-byte window.
The perturbed probe program fails natively (exit 1) and on target (HTIF 1: main returned 1), after 327 commit records against the plain program's 7514.

Velus's Obc passes decide which shapes print: switch normalization makes a complete switch's last branch its default, the two-way default insertion prints a skip branch as case 0: break;, and fusion merges adjacent switches on one scrutinee, so a clocked update prints as its own guard only when it reads a value computed outside its merge.

timing.interval_kind: attended agent-session provisioning-to-verdict interval; authoring before the freeze and the result and documents after the verdict are outside it

limits: No Velus or purecap compiler theorem is composed; neither Velus theorem covers library-mode output (F-467), and the printed, normalized and rewritten text the accepted compiler parses stays outside every theorem
The rewrite's soundness rests on its stated reading: Clight expressions have no side effect and Velus's layout has no fall-through; it is validated on the node and the control program only
Shapes outside the five declared ones are refused, not lowered; a producer that prints one meets this rewrite's refusal
Nothing bound to the accepted compiler is re-accepted, and Clight switch typing in the contained compiler is unchanged
No complete supervisor, lifecycle, transport or roster result; the M8a route is not re-selected and stays C
Velus, its printer, the normalizer and the accepted compiler are unchanged; their products stay in the native lane
